candidate.name: MCL Continuation Auction-Origin Surrender
candidate.base: v13 fixed three-tick route and failed-auction profit memory
candidate.change: add one causal structural invalidation boundary only to continuation positions
candidate.hypothesis: an accepted small-response continuation ceases to be financed once matched MCL fully crosses back through the price origin of the raw-turn auction

frozen_signal_and_failed_auction_owner.maturation: v13 exact one completed five-minute bar
frozen_signal_and_failed_auction_owner.route: follow raw-turn MCL responses at or below three ticks; fade larger responses
frozen_signal_and_failed_auction_owner.failed_auction_exit: v13 exact 0.5 percent activation and 25 percent running-MFE retention
frozen_signal_and_failed_auction_owner.costs: unchanged 3.52 primary and 5.52 stress round trip

continuation_surrender.primary_boundary: the matched-MCL close immediately preceding the five-minute raw-turn bar
continuation_surrender.neighbour_turn_open: the matched-MCL open of the raw-turn five-minute bar
continuation_surrender.neighbour_opposite_extreme: the raw-turn five-minute low for a long or high for a short
continuation_surrender.validity: the boundary must lie strictly on the risk side of the next-minute entry; otherwise no structural stop exists for that trade
continuation_surrender.trigger: from entry onward, exit when a completed causal one-minute bar trades through the fixed boundary
continuation_surrender.gap_law: execute at the worse of the one-minute open and the fixed boundary
continuation_surrender.after_exit: remain flat until the next raw macro turn; never synthesize re-entry

controls: apply the primary origin boundary to failed-auction positions instead of continuation
selection_law: auction-origin prior-close is the declared primary; semantic neighbours are sensitivity evidence only and cannot replace it from exposed outcomes
prohibitions: no numeric stop-distance or threshold sweep
no change to parity routing or failed-auction profit memory
no target, timeout, session, direction, volatility, calendar, or news interaction
no crown or live authority from exposed history
